landing.heroTitle: Create a CV that is truly yours
landing.heroTagline: Build a professional CV in minutes, make it match your style, and share it with a single link. Everything stays in your browser — private by default.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need, nothing you don't

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.body: Pick your accent color, font and layout, and reorder sections until the CV fits you — every change shows up live.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.body: Your CV is saved in your own browser. No account, no server, nobody reading along.

share.title: Share with a link
share.body: Your data travels inside the link itself, so it never touches a server — only people you send it to can open it.

free.title: Free to use
free.body: CV Studio is free. One day a few unobtrusive ads may cover the hosting costs — never trackers or pop-ups.

landing.step1Body: Add your experience, education, skills and languages.
landing.step2Body: Choose a layout, an accent color and a font — you see every change instantly.
landing.step3Body: Download a polished PDF or copy a private share link.
landing.ctaFinalBody: No account needed. Open the builder and start typing.

builder.title: CV builder
builder.intro: Fill in your details on the left and watch your CV take shape on the right. Everything is saved automatically in your browser.
builder.resetConfirm: This clears your entire CV from this browser. Are you sure?
builder.sampleConfirm: This replaces your current CV with the example. Continue?

shared.invalidTitle: This link doesn't contain a valid CV
